name: Aito
source:
Aito has despised vampires ever since his father was killed by one in the past.
He is always on the look-out for vampires, as his goal is to eradicate their entire existence from Earth.
He has confidence in everything he does, and although he usually speaks like he’s looking down on you, he’s actually very weak to being complimented.
He’s not very sociable, but he fully trusts those who know him and his temper.
